title: Remix
connectBody: Connect YouTube and the songs you liked on YouTube and YouTube Music gather here. Tap a song and it becomes a remix.
connectNote: Any Google account works. Google may warn the app is unverified: this is a small circle of friends, and we only read the list and never change anything.
offBody: The list leaves Remix and Muzak. Your likes on YouTube stay as they are.
ytExpired: Google closed access to your likes. Connect YouTube again and the list comes back.
ytDenied: Without YouTube permission there is no list. Try again and keep the YouTube box ticked.
ytFail: Could not connect YouTube, try again
errQuota: YouTube has run out of requests for today, try tomorrow
likesEmptyHint: Like a song on YouTube Music and it shows up here
offlineWait: No signal. The mix keeps going — I'll pick it up the moment the network is back
errLink: That is not a YouTube link
errLong: Too long — Remix is for songs up to 15 minutes
errBusy: Too many people right now, try again in a minute
profTagline: Your liked YouTube songs on a speed slider, from super slowed to super sped up. Tempo and space are chosen for the song itself; mp3 files with the cover.
installDesc: Opens like an app, a link is one tap away
installIosHint: In Safari: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
installGenericHint: In the browser menu choose Install or Add to Home Screen.
